title: Amplify Hosting AL2023 cannot build Console chat Docker; deploy-manifest missing
description:
## Problem

Restoring plexus.anth.us on a new Amplify app fails after Next.js builds: Amplify WEB_COMPUTE cannot find deploy-manifest.json unless the branch is Next.js SSR with AMPLIFY_MONOREPO_APP_ROOT=dashboard. Setting that env makes repo dashboard/amplify.yml win. That file starts /usr/local/bin/dockerd-entrypoint.sh, which does not exist on Amplify AL2023.

Console chat Docker is unused for this restore and will be re-engineered later.

## Change

Update dashboard/amplify.yml so a monorepo Amplify deploy skips Docker and the unused ConsoleChatResponder/MCP/backup/vector stacks, and still produces a Next.js .next artifact Amplify can package.

comments.text: Board audit 2026-10-17: verified against develop. dashboard/amplify.yml no longer starts dockerd. Its backend build patches backend.ts to skip the console worker, MCP, backup and vector stacks, and the frontend publishes the .next artifact for Amplify WEB_COMPUTE. Config-only change with no automated test; the patch targets were confirmed present in backend.ts.
